NOTICE_CONTENT: METHOD HORROR contains darkness, sudden loud sounds, a pursuing creature, flickering lights and occasional jump scares. There is no gore.
NOTICE_ACCESS: You can reduce flashing, camera motion and jump-scare intensity, enable subtitles and sound captions, and adjust brightness in Settings → Accessibility and Audio.
NOTICE_HEADPHONES: Headphones recommended: sound tells you where the threat is.
NAME_INTRO: This is your display name. It is stored only on this device and is not an account or a password.
NAME_PRIVACY: Online play (when available) creates a separate guest identity issued by the server. Your name never grants access to anything, and other players may share it.
NAME_ERR_CHARS: Some characters are not allowed (brackets, control or invisible characters).
MENU_CONTINUE_FAILED: That checkpoint could not be loaded.
COINS_LOCAL_TOOLTIP: Coins earned offline are stored on this device.
SAVE_RECOVERED_BODY: Some saved data was damaged and has been restored from a backup or reset to defaults.
SOLO_OVERWRITE_BODY: You have a saved checkpoint. Starting a new run will discard it.
MAP_COMING_LATER_TIP: This location is planned but not built yet.
MAP_VARIANT_FAILED: The level could not generate a solvable layout. Please try again.
MAP_TUTORIAL_DESC: A safe walkthrough of the basics. No threat.
MAP_HOUSE_DESC: A caretaker's house on the edge of town, chained shut from outside. Restore the power, open the basement, repair the garage door and escape The Watcher.
MAP_BLACK_WARD_DESC: A closed hospital wing where METHOD ran sensory-isolation trials. Card doors, emergency circuits, observation rooms — and a nurse who cannot see you, but hears everything.
MAP_LAST_TRAIN_DESC: A sealed underground station where METHOD tested what people hear in the dark. Power the signal box, route the evacuation train, call it — and hold out until it comes.
MAP_SILENT_SCHOOL_DESC: Classrooms, locked wings and investigation by sound. Planned.
DIFF_STORY_DESC: For the atmosphere. The Watcher is slower (−20% speed) and less perceptive (−40% hearing, −30% sight). You survive 3 hits. Extra batteries, wide timing window, hints after 1 minute, checkpoints on. Coins ×0.75.
DIFF_NORMAL_DESC: The intended experience. You survive 2 hits. One spare battery, hints after 2 minutes, checkpoints on. Coins ×1.
DIFF_HARD_DESC: The Watcher is faster (+10%), hears better (+25%), sees farther (+20%) and searches longer. No spare battery, narrow timing window, hints after 4 minutes. Coins ×1.5.
DIFF_NIGHTMARE_DESC: +20% speed, +50% hearing. One hit is fatal. Fewer batteries, no hints, no checkpoints. Coins ×2.
BRIEF_HOUSE_1: The letter had no return address — only one word stamped in red: METHOD. Inside, an address on the edge of town.
BRIEF_HOUSE_2: The moment you stepped in, the front door slammed and chains rattled on the other side. The power is out. Something heavy is circling the house.
BRIEF_HOUSE_3: Find a way out. It listens: noise brings it to you. Light lets it see you. Lamps flicker when it is near.
BRIEF_TUTORIAL_1: Welcome to the METHOD Orientation Wing. Nothing here can hurt you.
BRIEF_TUTORIAL_2: Learn to move, use your flashlight, open locked doors, hide and read clues.
TIP_1: Sprinting is loud. Walking is quieter, crouching quieter still.
TIP_2: Turning your flashlight off makes you harder to see — and harder to navigate.
TIP_3: Doors creak. The Watcher hears them.
TIP_4: Don't hide right where it lost sight of you: it may check.
TIP_5: Spare batteries can be used from the inventory.
TIP_6: Lit rooms make you easier to spot. Light switches work once the power is back.
HUD_HINT_AVAILABLE: A hint is available — open the pause menu (Esc).
HUD_HINT_AVAILABLE_TOUCH: A hint is available in the pause menu.
HUD_CRANK: Crank-start: %d / %d — press in the marked window
HUD_DOWNED: You are down. A teammate can revive you.
NOTE_ENEMY_ARRIVED: The front door just opened… and closed. You are not alone.
NOTE_FINAL_PHASE: The motor is loud. It knows where you are going.
DOOR_LOCKED_KEY: Locked. A small brass key would fit.
DOOR_MAGLOCK: A magnetic lock. Without power it won't release.
DOOR_CHAINED: It won't budge. Chains rattle on the other side.
CAGE_LOCKED: The cage gate is locked by the keypad.
GARAGE_STUCK: The door won't lift by hand. The motor beside it is dead.
FUSE_SHORTED: A bang and a shower of sparks — the fuse popped out onto the floor. Everything heard that.
MOTOR_BROKEN: The drive belt and gear are missing.
CRANK_MISS: The starter slips with a loud clank.
ITEM_USE_CONTEXT: Use items by looking at what they fit.
OBJ_CAGE: Open the storage cage in the basement
OBJ_TAPE: Listen to the tape in the study
HINTS_DISABLED: Hints are off for this difficulty or setting.
HINT_EXPLORE_1: Try the front door in the foyer.
HINT_EXPLORE_2: The garage, through the hallway, has a door to the outside.
HINT_POWER_1: Fuses lie around the ground floor. Some rooms are locked — look for a small key in drawers and on shelves.
HINT_POWER_2: The fuse panel is in the utility room, through the garage.
HINT_POWER_3: The breaker chart pinned in the kitchen names the scorched socket. Fill the other three.
HINT_CAGE_1: Power released the basement maglock. The stairs are past the utility room.
HINT_CAGE_2: Four red digits are painted around the house, each beside a symbol: kitchen, living-room fireplace, garage, basement.
HINT_CAGE_3: The keypad plate shows the order of the symbols. Enter the digit beside each symbol in that order.
HINT_REPAIR_1: The drive gear is in the basement storage cage.
HINT_REPAIR_2: The drive belt is somewhere in the house — check shelves, the basement and the study.
HINT_REPAIR_3: Assemble belt and gear on the garage workbench, then install the assembly on the motor beside the garage door.
HINT_START_1: Press while the needle crosses the marked window. Three good pulls start the motor.
HINT_START_2: Misses are loud. A partner standing next to the motor widens the window.
HINT_ESCAPE_1: Get under the garage door as soon as there's room. Crouch to slip under it.
PAUSE_ONLINE_NOTE: The match keeps running while this menu is open.
RESTART_BODY: Progress in this run will be lost.
RESTART_CHECKPOINT_BODY: You will return to your last checkpoint.
LEAVE_BODY: You will return to the main menu.
LEAVE_BODY_PROGRESS: Your last checkpoint stays available from the main menu. Progress since then is lost.
INV_EMPTY_DESC: Items you pick up appear here.
INV_USE_CONTEXT: Use this item by looking at what it fits in the world.
INV_CONTEXT_HINT: Most items are used in place: look at the fuse panel holding a fuse, at a locked door holding its key. Dropped items stay on the floor where you left them.
ITEM_FUSE_DESC: A ceramic cartridge fuse. The panel in the utility room has four sockets.
ITEM_DRIVE_BELT_DESC: A rubber belt from the garage door motor. Brittle but intact.
ITEM_DRIVE_GEAR_DESC: A toothed steel gear for the motor. Someone locked the spare away.
ITEM_DRIVE_ASSEMBLY_DESC: Belt and gear fitted together. Ready to mount on the motor.
ITEM_BATTERY_DESC: Fully recharges your flashlight. Use it from the inventory.
ITEM_ORIENTATION_KEY_DESC: A METHOD access card for the training wing.
KEYPAD_ORDER: Symbol order printed on the plate
DEATH_BODY: The Watcher found you. The house is quiet again.
RESULT_LOCAL_NOTE: Offline coins are stored on this device only and are separate from any online wallet.
RESULT_ALREADY_CLAIMED: Rewards for this match were already granted.
SET_RESET_BODY: All settings on this tab return to their defaults.
SET_RELOAD_NOTE: Applies the next time a location loads.
SET_INGAME_NOTE: Changes apply immediately. Personal settings never change the shared difficulty or rules of a multiplayer match.
SET_MP_NOTE: In multiplayer, difficulty and rules are set by the room; these options only affect you.
SET_PAD_NOTE: Controller: left stick move, right stick look, A use, B crouch, X inventory, Y flashlight, L3/LT sprint, Start pause.
SET_QUALITY_PRESET_TIP: Sets several graphics options at once. Changing any of them switches to Custom.
SET_RENDER_SCALE_TIP: Resolution of the 3D view only; menus and text stay sharp. Lower is faster and saves battery.
SET_UPSCALER_TIP: How the 3D view is enlarged when render scale is below 100%. FSR is sharper.
SET_DYNAMIC_RESOLUTION_TIP: Temporarily lowers 3D resolution (down to 60% of your setting) when the frame rate drops.
SET_SHADOWS_TIP: Off: no dynamic shadows. Low: flashlight shadows. High: also shadows from key lamps.
SET_LIGHT_QUALITY_TIP: High enables moonlight shafts with shadows and lamp shadows.
SET_TEXTURE_QUALITY_TIP: Low uses half-resolution textures and less memory.
SET_DRAW_DISTANCE_TIP: How far the camera renders and how thick the fog is.
SET_GLOW_TIP: Soft bloom around bulbs and bright lights.
SET_FILM_GRAIN_TIP: Subtle animated noise over the image.
SET_EXPOSURE_TIP: Overall brightness of the 3D scene. Raise it if you cannot see your surroundings.
SET_FOV_TIP: Vertical field of view. Higher shows more but can cause discomfort for some players.
SET_FRAME_CAP_TIP: Lower limits save battery and reduce heat.
SET_BATTERY_SAVER_TIP: Caps the frame rate at 30 and the render scale at 75%.
SET_VSYNC_TIP: Prevents tearing. May add input latency.
SET_WINDOW_SIZE_TIP: Size of the game window when windowed.
SET_VOL_SFX_TIP: Footsteps, doors, the Watcher and other world sounds.
SET_DYNAMIC_RANGE_TIP: Night mode compresses loud and quiet sounds closer together.
SET_SUBTITLES_TIP: Shows recorded speech as text with the speaker's name.
SET_SOUND_CAPTIONS_TIP: Describes important sounds and their direction, e.g. [Heavy footsteps — behind you].
SET_CAPTION_SIZE_TIP: Text size for subtitles and captions.
SET_CAPTION_BACKGROUND_TIP: Opacity of the box behind subtitles.
SET_TOUCH_SENSITIVITY_TIP: Camera speed when dragging on the right side of the screen.
SET_PAD_SENSITIVITY_TIP: Camera speed for the right stick.
SET_LOOK_ACCELERATION_TIP: Camera speeds up the longer you hold the right stick.
SET_JOYSTICK_MODE_TIP: Floating: appears where your thumb lands. Fixed: stays in place.
SET_SPRINT_MODE_TIP: Hold the button, or tap to toggle.
SET_CROUCH_MODE_TIP: Hold the button, or tap to toggle.
SET_HAPTICS_TIP: Strength of phone and controller vibration.
SET_TOUCH_CONTROLS_TIP: Auto shows them on touch devices.
SET_TOUCH_BUTTON_SCALE_TIP: Size of on-screen buttons and joystick.
SET_HINTS_TIP: How soon hints unlock. Difficulty can disable hints entirely.
SET_JUMP_SCARES_TIP: Reduced lowers the volume of scare stingers and removes the screen flash.
SET_SHOW_PING_TIP: Displays your ping in online matches.
SET_AUTO_RECONNECT_TIP: Tries to rejoin a match you were disconnected from.
SET_HIGH_CONTRAST_TIP: Brighter item glints and a stronger focus reticle.
SET_REDUCED_FLASHING_TIP: Lamps dim slowly instead of strobing; scare flashes are softened.
SET_REDUCED_MOTION_TIP: Disables head bob, camera sway, shake and menu camera drift.
TOUCH_LAYOUT_HINT: Drag the buttons to move them.
SHOP_NOTE: Cosmetic items only — they never change gameplay. Earn coins by playing. No real-money purchases.
SHOP_FAILED: The purchase could not be completed.
SHOP_INSUFFICIENT_BODY: You need %d more coins. Escape, find METHOD files and complete optional objectives to earn more.
COS_FL_STANDARD_DESC: A dependable black flashlight with a warm-white beam.
COS_FL_SODIUM_DESC: Brass body, amber beam. Like old street lamps.
COS_FL_METHOD_DESC: Crimson casing stamped with the METHOD mark.
COS_BADGE_KEY_DESC: For those who found their way out.
PROGRESS_FILE_LOCKED_TIP: Find this file in the location to read it.
PROFILE_IDENTITY_BODY: Your profile lives on this device only. There is no account or cloud save in this version: uninstalling the game or clearing its data removes your progress, coins and cosmetics.
PROFILE_DATA_BODY: Deletes your profile, progress, coins, cosmetics, checkpoint and settings from this device.
PROFILE_RESET_BODY: This permanently deletes your profile, progress, coins, cosmetics, checkpoint and settings on this device. This cannot be undone.

TAPE_HOUSE_1: Field Site 01, session forty. The subject says the house is 'too quiet to be empty'.
TAPE_HOUSE_2: When he cannot see a thing, he listens for it. When he hears it, he goes to look.
TAPE_HOUSE_3: The lenses do not come off. We have chained the doors — for his sake, and for ours.
TAPE_HOUSE_4: If you are hearing this: stay quiet, keep to the dark, and do not let him watch you leave.
NOTE_WELCOME_B:
Thank you for accepting our invitation.

The house has been prepared. The caretaker will not disturb you while the lights are out — he prefers the dark, as do we.

Please observe carefully. Please do not look for him. He will find you.

— METHOD, Field Division
NOTE_BREAKER_B:
Panel is in the utility room — through the garage.

I — hall & kitchen
II — basement maglock
III — garage & stairs
IV — study & living room

Socket %s is scorched inside. NEVER put a fuse in it. It bangs like a gunshot and HE hears it.

— E.M.
NOTE_DIARY_B:
Day 211.

They fitted the lenses today. Dr. Varga says I will learn to see what people hide. My eyes itch where there are no eyes.

I asked when I could go home. She said: Edwin, you are home.
NOTE_KEYPAD_B:
I can't keep numbers in my head anymore, so I painted them where I'd see them. Red paint, next to a shape. Kitchen. Fireplace. Garage. Down here.

The keypad plate shows which shape comes first.

The gear is in the cage. Don't let him see you take it.
NOTE_STUDY_B:
STATUS: Subject no longer sleeps. Subject describes 'hearing the light'. Subject must not be left without stimulus.

Recommendation: keep the house occupied.

— I.V.
NOTE_GARAGE_B:
Belt and gear pulled after he tried to leave. Spare gear locked in the basement cage. Belt is somewhere in the house.

Put them together on the bench. Mount on the motor. It's an old hand starter: wait for the needle, pull in rhythm.

It is LOUD. Be ready to run.
FILE_HOUSE_KITCHEN_B:
12 boxes, incandescent bulbs, 40 W.
Note from subject: 'soft light only'.
Note from Field Division: approved. Light keeps him calm. Darkness keeps him curious.
FILE_HOUSE_LIVING_B: The Marsh family, summer, before the trial. Every face has been scratched out except one. The caretaker's eyes have been circled in red pencil, again and again.
FILE_HOUSE_STUDY_B: Field Sites 02 (the Black Ward) and 03 (Last Train) report subjects with the same symptoms. Recommend we stop calling them subjects.
FILE_HOUSE_GARAGE_B: Last departure: 14 October 1998. Driver: I. Varga. Destination: [redacted]. The car was found the next morning, still in this garage, engine warm.
FILE_HOUSE_UTILITY_B:
Maglock fitted to the basement door. Power must stay on, or he gets out.
Handwritten below: 'Power must stay off, or he gets out. Which is it?'
FILE_HOUSE_BASEMENT_B:
Observation reversed. The subject is now observing the staff.
All Field Division personnel recalled. Site sealed.
Someone keeps sending invitations.
TOBJ_KEY: Find the keycard in the dark room and open the next door
TOBJ_CODE: Open the last door with the keypad
THINT_MOVE: Walk toward the door in front of you.
THINT_KEY_1: Turn on your flashlight in the dark room.
THINT_KEY_2: The keycard is on the table or the shelf. Then look at the locked door and interact.
THINT_HIDE: Look at the locker and interact to hide. Interact again to leave.
THINT_CODE_1: Four red digits are painted on the left wall, each beside a symbol.
THINT_CODE_2: The keypad plate shows the symbol order. Enter the digits in that order.
THINT_EXIT: Walk through the open door at the end.
TDOOR_KEYCARD: Locked. It needs the orientation keycard.
TDOOR_CODE: Locked. Use the keypad beside it.
TNOTE_B:
Welcome, observer.

In the field you will meet things that hunt by sound and by sight. Walk, don't run. Keep your light low when you can. If you are seen, break the line of sight before you hide — and never hide where they last saw you.
TUT_SIGN_MOVE: MOVE: W A S D   ·   LOOK: MOUSE   ·   INTERACT: E (hold for some actions)
TUT_SIGN_MOVE_TOUCH: MOVE: left thumb   ·   LOOK: drag on the right   ·   USE: tap USE (hold for some actions)
TUT_SIGN_LIGHT: FLASHLIGHT: F   ·   CROUCH: C   ·   SPRINT: SHIFT (loud)
TUT_SIGN_LIGHT_TOUCH: LIGHT toggles your flashlight   ·   DUCK crouches   ·   RUN sprints (loud)
TUT_SIGN_CODE: RED DIGITS · SYMBOLS · ORDER ON THE KEYPAD

BRIEF_WARD_1: The second letter came with a visitor badge: CLINICAL ANNEX 02 — NIGHT SHIFT. The ambulance bay shutter was open when you arrived. It is closed now.
BRIEF_WARD_2: The power is out. Somewhere down the corridor, someone is humming a lullaby.
BRIEF_WARD_3: She is blind. Light means nothing to her — sound is everything. Walk softly, crouch near her, and freeze when the humming stops.
WOBJ_TAPE: Listen to the interview tape in the observation wing
WHINT_EXPLORE_1: The ambulance bay is through the doors on the west side of reception.
WHINT_EXPLORE_2: Try the shutter at the far end of the bay.
WHINT_STAFF_1: The staff door in the main corridor needs a blue staff card.
WHINT_STAFF_2: Staff cards turn up in reception, triage, the ward, maintenance and the bay.
WHINT_POWER_1: The emergency panel is in the generator room, off the staff corridor.
WHINT_POWER_2: The generator needs its starter relay. Look on shelves and in the pharmacy, the ward and maintenance.
WHINT_POWER_3: The electrician's schematic in maintenance lists which circuits must be live. Switch only those on, then pull the start lever.
WHINT_SECURITY_1: The red security card opens the observation wing at the east end of the corridor.
WHINT_SECURITY_2: With power on, each observation room's monitor shows a bed number and a reading.
WHINT_SECURITY_3: The night-round sheet in the staff room gives the bed order. Enter the readings in that order on the security keypad.
WHINT_BAY_1: The shutter control is the console in the security office.
WHINT_ESCAPE_1: The shutter is loud and slow. She will come. Get out the moment it is high enough.
NOTE_ADMISSION_B:
NIGHT VISITOR — authorized by I. Varga.

The ward is in isolation protocol. Lights are off by design. Please do not speak above a whisper.

If Sister Agnes comes to you, stand still. She will not hurt what she cannot hear.
NOTE_SCHEMATIC_B:
Generator room, off the staff corridor. Fit the starter relay first.

C1 corridor lighting — %s
C2 lift motors — %s
C3 security doors — %s
C4 pharmacy cold room — %s
C5 ventilation — %s

Only LIVE circuits ON. Start with a faulted circuit on and the whole board trips. Loudly.
NOTE_ROSTER_B:
Observation wing, monitors only — do NOT open the cells.

Tonight's round: Bed %d, Bed %d, Bed %d, Bed %d.

Security door code changes nightly: the last reading on each monitor, in round order.
NOTE_SEDATION_B:
Subject 11 (Sr. Agnes) — refused sedation again. Says the drugs make the ward 'too loud to think'.

She hums to cover the noise. When she stops humming, she is listening.

We moved the night staff to the observation wing.
NOTE_ISOLATION_B:
Week 9 of auditory isolation. Bandages stay on.

She located a dropped pen across the room in under four seconds. She did not react to the flashlight test at all.

I.V.: 'She no longer needs eyes. She needs us to be quiet.'
TAPE_WARD_1: Annex 02, interview eleven. Sister, can you hear me from there?
TAPE_WARD_2: She says she can hear our hearts, and that they are very loud tonight.
TAPE_WARD_3: She asks us to stop walking. She asks politely, the first time.
TAPE_WARD_4: If you are hearing this: crouch, breathe slowly, and do not run unless you must.
DOOR_STAFF_ONLY: Staff only. The reader blinks red — you need a staff card.
DOOR_KEYPAD_LOCKED: Locked. The keypad beside it controls the lock.
SHUTTER_NO_POWER: The shutter motor is dead. It needs power — and someone to work the control console.
CONSOLE_NO_POWER: The console is dead. No power.
MONITOR_DARK: The monitor is dark. No power.
GENERATOR_NO_RELAY: The lever moves, nothing happens. The relay socket is empty.
CIRCUIT_TRIPPED: A bang from the board — every breaker threw itself open. Wrong circuits. Everything heard that.
ITEM_STAFF_CARD_DESC: Blue, one white stripe. NIGHT STAFF — ANNEX 02.
ITEM_SECURITY_CARD_DESC: Red, two white stripes. OBSERVATION WING.
ITEM_STARTER_RELAY_DESC: A heavy relay with four brass pins. Labelled GEN-1.
ITEM_MAINT_KEY_DESC: A steel key on a red tag: TUNNELS — AUTHORIZED STAFF.
ITEM_POWER_CELL_DESC: A heavy traction cell with a carry handle. The signal box takes two.
TRAIN_ETA: Station announcement: evacuation service arriving in %d seconds.
TRAIN_ARRIVED: The train is here. Doors open. Get on.
FRAME_NO_POWER: The route indicator stays dark. The frame has no power.
ROUTE_CONFLICT: The conflict bell rings — the levers don't match a safe route. Anything down here heard that.
BRIEF_TRAIN_1: The third letter was a ticket: KESSEL STREET — LAST SERVICE. The station was closed in 1987. The gates let you in anyway.
BRIEF_TRAIN_2: Behind you, the street stairs came down in a roar of concrete. Down on the platform, a lamp swings in the tunnel.
BRIEF_TRAIN_3: The Lineman sees only along his headlamp beam — but in it, darkness won't hide you. When a train that shouldn't exist roars past, nothing can hear you near the tracks.
SOBJ_HOLD: Hold out until the train arrives
SHINT_EXPLORE_1: The street exit is at the south end of the ticket hall.
SHINT_EXPLORE_2: Take a closer look at the collapsed stairs.
SHINT_MAINT_1: The maintenance door is at the east end of the platform, down the stairs.
SHINT_MAINT_2: The key is somewhere in the ticket hall or on the platform: the office, the kiosk, the benches.
SHINT_POWER_1: The signal box battery rack takes two power cells.
SHINT_POWER_2: Power cells turn up on the platform, in the ticket hall and in the maintenance store.
SHINT_ROUTE_1: The evacuation route card is in the ticket office.
SHINT_ROUTE_2: Set each lever in the signal box to Normal or Reverse as the card says.
SHINT_ROUTE_3: Then press the plunger on the frame. A wrong route rings a loud bell.
SHINT_CALL_1: Use the blue help point on the platform wall.
SHINT_HOLD_1: The approaching train is loud and he will come. Hide, keep moving, or use the passing trains as cover.
SHINT_ESCAPE_1: Get through the open doors of the train.
STATION_EXIT_COLLAPSED: The stairs to the street have collapsed. Concrete and twisted steel fill the passage. There is no way through.
DOOR_MAINT_LOCKED: Maintenance — authorized staff. Locked; it needs the maintenance key.
HELP_POINT_NO_ROUTE: Static, then a voice: 'No route set to Platform 2. Set the evacuation route from the signal box.'
NOTE_ROUTE_B:
EMERGENCY SERVICE TO PLATFORM 2 (via depot line)

Lever 1 — %s
Lever 2 — %s
